The final analytic weight was constructed as the product of the demographic adjustment and the geographic adjustment and then normalized so that the mean weight equaled one. Weighting diagnostics indicated a design effect of 2.08, yielding an effective sample size of approximately 263 respondents.

Consumer sentiment was measured using five questions modeled after the University of Michigan's Survey of Consumers. Responses were combined to produce the Virginia Consumer Sentiment Index.
